d: Long, flowing salmon-pink hair is styled with a high, voluminous ponytail and jagged bangs. The visible right eye is a sharp, focused golden-yellow, while the left eye is covered by a white medical patch. Appearing as a mature adult with a lean, athletic build, the character wears a stylized kimono consisting of a dark navy-blue outer jacket over a white garment with red and navy circular patterns, cinched at the waist by a thick red rope belt. Signature details include a long red katana with a gold hilt held across the chest and black lace-up sandals.
